content.clinical_guidelines: The document outlines various studies and guidelines related to peripheral arterial disease (PAD), its diagnosis, and treatment methods. Topics include ankle-brachial index (ABI) for screening PAD, functional decline in elderly patients with PAD, and associations of symptoms and mobility. Specific treatments, such as transcutaneous oxygen measurements and exercise interventions, are discussed. The importance of early detection and prevention strategies is highlighted. Studies also focus on cardiovascular events, diabetes, and associated risks in patients with PAD.
